abstract: The ability to reliably detect aberrant glycosylation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) may have profound implications for the diagnosis and monitoring of malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, germ cell tumors, other malignancies, and pregnancy complications. To become a clinically useful assay, however, this discrimination of glycoforms should be possible on minimally treated biological specimens. Towards this end, we have developed a lectin-based sandwich-type immunoassay to compare the glycosylation patterns of hCG among urine specimens from patients presenting with a normal pregnancy, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and male germ cell tumors using carbohydrate-free antibody fragments as capture reagents and a panel of eight lectins, five recognizing neutral sugars and three recognizing sialic acid. There was no significant difference in the binding of any of the lectins to hCG in the urine of women over the gestational range of 6-38 weeks. Three lectins, however, exhibited differential binding to urinary hCG derived from these normal pregnant controls and that from patients with malignant forms of gestational trophoblastic disease and male germ cell tumors. Galanthus nivalis agglutinin and Maackia amurensis lectin, which bind terminal mannose and alpha(2-3)sialic acid, respectively, preferentially bound pregnancy-derived hCG, whereas the lectin, wheat germ agglutinin, which binds sialic acid and beta(1-4)N-acetylglucosamine, exhibited decreased binding to pregnancy-derived hCG compared to that from patients with male germ cell tumors and malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. The differential binding observed with these three promising lectins is most encouraging and warrants further examination. The experimental paradigm also holds promise for the development of comparable assays for other glycosylated tumor markers.
abstract_ja:
ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の異常な糖鎖付加を検出できれば、悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）、胚細胞腫瘍、その他の悪性腫瘍、妊娠合併症の診断と経過観察に大きな意義をもちうる。ただし臨床で有用なアッセイとするには、最小限の処理しか行っていない生体検体でグリコフォームを識別できる必要がある。この目的のため、我々はレクチンを用いたサンドイッチ型免疫測定法を開発し、正常妊娠、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、男性胚細胞腫瘍の患者尿中hCGの糖鎖付加パターンを比較した。捕捉試薬には糖鎖を持たない抗体フラグメントを用い、中性糖を認識する5種と唾液酸を認識する3種の計8種のレクチンを用いた。
妊娠6〜38週の女性尿中では、いずれのレクチンの結合にも有意差はなかった。しかし3種のレクチンは、正常妊娠由来hCGと、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の悪性型および男性胚細胞腫瘍の患者由来hCGとで異なる結合を示した。Galanthus nivalis agglutininとMaackia amurensis lectinは、それぞれ末端マンノースおよびα(2-3)唾液酸に結合するが、妊娠由来hCGに優先的に結合した。一方、唾液酸とβ(1-4)N-アセチルグルコサミンに結合する小麦胚芽凝集素(WGA)は、妊娠由来hCGへの結合が低下し、男性胚細胞腫瘍および悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍由来hCGでは結合が減少していた。
これら3種のレクチンによる差異は非常に有望であり、さらなる検討に値する。本実験の枠組みは、他の糖鎖付加腫瘍マーカーに対する同様のアッセイの開発にも期待が持てる。
